inlineSql: Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
Select * From BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '
SELECT A.BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,A.CO_BOOK As BookL FROM BOOK_DATA AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.BOOK_NAME
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
Select * From LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? '
Select LC_CODE As CodeL,LC_NAME As NameL,LC_ADD1 As AddressL,LC_CITY As CityL FROM LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LC_CODE

SELECT A.CO_BOOK,B.AC_NAME,A.BOOK_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GSTNO,E.BOOK_SR_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.TOT_AMT,C.STATE_CODE,C.STATE_NAME,A.R_CHARG,D.TAX_PRC As TaxPrc,A.NET_AMT,A.DISC_AMT from (((TAX_DATA AS A INNER JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN STATE_MAST AS C ON B.AC_STATE = C.STATE_NAME)LEFT JOIN TAX_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.TAX_CODE = D.TAX_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = E.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND D.SR_NO = 0

SELECT C.STATE_CODE,C.STATE_NAME,A.TAX_CODE,D.TAX_PRC As TaxPrc,Sum(A.NET_AMT-A.DISC_AMT) As NetAmt from (((TAX_DATA AS A INNER JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN STATE_MAST AS C ON B.AC_STATE = C.STATE_NAME)LEFT JOIN TAX_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.TAX_CODE = D.TAX_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = E.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND D.SR_NO = 0

SELECT A.CO_BOOK,B.AC_NAME,C.BOOK_SR_NAME As BillBook,B.AC_GSTNO,A.BILL_NO,A.BILL_DATE,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.BOOK_NAME,E.BOOK_SR_NAME,F.STATE_CODE,F.STATE_NAME,D.TAX_PRC As TaxPrc,A.NET_AMT,A.TOT_AMT from ((((TAX_DATA AS A INNER JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.BILL_DBCD = C.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN TAX_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.TAX_CODE = D.TAX_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = E.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN STATE_MAST AS F ON B.AC_STATE = F.STATE_NAME WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND D.SR_NO = 0

SELECT C.STATE_CODE,C.STATE_NAME,A.TAX_CODE,D.TAX_PRC As TaxPrc,Sum(A.NET_AMT) As NetAmt from (((TAX_DATA AS A INNER JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN STATE_MAST AS C ON B.AC_STATE = C.STATE_NAME)LEFT JOIN TAX_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.TAX_CODE = D.TAX_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = E.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND D.SR_NO = 0

SELECT A.CO_BOOK,A.BOOK_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GSTNO,E.BOOK_SR_NAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.TOT_AMT,C.STATE_CODE,C.STATE_NAME,A.R_CHARG,D.TAX_PRC As TaxPrc,A.NET_AMT from (((TAX_DATA AS A INNER JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN STATE_MAST AS C ON B.AC_STATE = C.STATE_NAME)LEFT JOIN TAX_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.TAX_CODE = D.TAX_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = E.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND D.SR_NO = 0

SELECT A.CO_BOOK,C.BOOK_SR_NAME As BillBook,B.AC_GSTNO,A.BILL_NO,A.BILL_DATE,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.BOOK_NAME,E.BOOK_SR_NAME,F.STATE_CODE,F.STATE_NAME,D.TAX_PRC As TaxPrc,A.NET_AMT,A.TOT_AMT from ((((TAX_DATA AS A INNER JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.BILL_DBCD = C.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN TAX_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.TAX_CODE = D.TAX_CODE)LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = E.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN STATE_MAST AS F ON B.AC_STATE = F.STATE_NAME WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND D.SR_NO = 0

SELECT SUM(IIF(TAX_TYPE IN ('IGST','SGST'),A.NET_AMT,0)) As NetAmt,SUM(IIF(TAX_TYPE = 'IGST',TAX_AMT,0)) As IgstAmt,SUM(IIF(TAX_TYPE = 'CGST',TAX_AMT,0)) As CgstAmt,SUM(IIF(TAX_TYPE = 'SGST',TAX_AMT,0)) As SgstAmt FROM TAX_DATA AS A WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT C.STATE_CODE,B.AC_STATE,SUM(IIF(A.TAX_TYPE IN ('IGST','SGST'),A.NET_AMT,0)) As NetAmt,SUM(IIF(A.TAX_TYPE = 'IGST',TAX_AMT,0)) As IgstAmt FROM (TAX_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE)LEFT JOIN STATE_MAST AS C ON B.AC_STATE = C.STATE_NAME WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.AC_STATE <> ' ? ' AND AC_STATE <> ''
